skills.name: Port discovery
skills.description: Map open ports on a target host.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. net.portscan on the target with a sensible port range.
2. Note each open port and probable service.
3. Cross-check with http.capture when the port serves web content.
4. Report the map with service guesses.

skills.name: Network diagnostics
skills.description: Run connectivity checks before blaming the app.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. process.exec ping/curl checks against the target host.
2. Compare DNS resolution vs direct IP.
3. Classify: DNS, routing, TLS, or application-layer failure.
4. Report with concrete numbers (latency, status codes).

skills.name: HTTP capture session
skills.description: Capture app traffic for inspection.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. http.capture to start the session.
2. Exercise the app flow on device (androidclickelement etc).
3. http.history to review captured requests.
4. Stop capture; summarize interesting endpoints.

skills.name: Traffic history analysis
skills.description: Mine captured traffic for API behavior.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. http.history to list requests.
2. Group by endpoint; note verbs and status codes.
3. file.write an annotated summary for the session.
4. Flag auth headers and tokens (report presence, never values).

skills.name: Request replay
skills.description: Re-send a captured request with changes.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Pick the request from http.history.
2. http.replay with the intended modification.
3. Compare the response to the original.
4. Document what the change caused; stop at any auth error.

skills.name: Request repetition
skills.description: Repeat a request to test consistency.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. http.capture.repeat with the target request and count.
2. Keep counts modest; do not load services.
3. Analyze response variance (latency, status, body deltas).
4. Summarize stability findings.

skills.name: Traffic modification testing
skills.description: Modify requests in flight to test server trust.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. http.capture.modify to set the interception rule.
2. Trigger the flow in the app.
3. Review modified vs original responses.
4. Restore the rule afterwards; note any state corruption.

skills.name: Packet capture analysis
skills.description: Deep packet inspection with tcpdump.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. tcpdump.capture with a tight filter (host or port).
2. Reproduce the network action.
3. packet.capture.stop to end collection.
4. Analyze the pcap; summarize protocols and anomalies.

skills.name: Traffic environment status
skills.description: Know the capture environment before analysis.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. traffic.capture.info for VPN/capture readiness.
2. Resolve any missing prerequisites before starting.
3. Confirm capture works with a test request.
4. Only then run the real session.

skills.name: HTTPS traffic insight
skills.description: Understand what is visible under TLS.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Note that raw tcpdump shows SNI/IP only for HTTPS.
2. Use http.capture (VPN-layer) for app-level visibility.
3. If nothing is visible, the app may pin certificates; say so.
4. Report what layer each observation came from.

skills.name: Proxy chain testing
skills.description: Validate proxies before relying on them.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Test connectivity through each proxy with process.exec curl.
2. Note latency and failure modes.
3. Discard dead or leaking proxies.
4. Report the working set with speeds.

skills.name: DNS problem isolation
skills.description: Diagnose DNS failures precisely.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. process.exec nslookup/getent against the failing host.
2. Compare with a known-good resolver.
3. Test IP-direct access to separate DNS from routing.
4. Recommend the fix (resolver change, hosts entry, VPN).

skills.name: API surface discovery
skills.description: Enumerate an app API from traffic.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture a broad app walkthrough with http.capture.
2. Collect unique endpoints from http.history.
3. Order by importance (auth, data, config).
4. Document request/response shapes for key endpoints.

skills.name: Auth flow analysis
skills.description: Understand how an app authenticates.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture login from start to token issuance.
2. Identify token type (bearer, cookie, custom header).
3. Note refresh mechanisms in the traffic.
4. Summarize the flow with a sequence sketch.

skills.name: Webhook behavior probe
skills.description: Test webhook receivers safely.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Send minimal test payloads with http.replay.
2. Verify receipt in the target system.
3. Test rejection paths (bad signature) deliberately.
4. Report observed validation behavior.

skills.name: Rate limit detection
skills.description: Find an API rate limits without abuse.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Send a small, increasing sequence with http.capture.repeat.
2. Watch for 429s or throttling signals.
3. Stop at the first limit signal.
4. Document the observed thresholds.

skills.name: Error response mapping
skills.description: Catalog API error behavior.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Replay requests with deliberately invalid fields (http.replay).
2. Collect error shapes and codes.
3. Group into client vs server error classes.
4. Summarize the error contract for the API.

skills.name: TLS handshake diagnostics
skills.description: Debug certificate and handshake failures.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. process.exec openssl s_client or curl -v against the host.
2. Read the certificate chain and verify dates.
3. Classify: expired, untrusted, pinned, or protocol mismatch.
4. Recommend the precise fix.

skills.name: Bandwidth measurement
skills.description: Quantify transfer speeds to a host.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Download a known-size object via process.exec curl -o with timing.
2. Compute throughput.
3. Repeat at different times if variance matters.
4. Report a small table of runs.

skills.name: WebSocket session tracing
skills.description: Observe WS frame flows.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture the session with tcpdump.capture or app-level tools.
2. Note handshake upgrade and frame patterns.
3. Identify control vs data frames.
4. Summarize the protocol rhythm.

skills.name: HTTP header audit
skills.description: Assess security headers of a web target.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Fetch headers with process.exec curl -I.
2. Check HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, cookie flags.
3. Note missing protections with impact notes.
4. Use web.headervuln for the automated pass and merge results.

skills.name: VPN auto-tuning
skills.description: Let the network tuner pick a working path.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Confirm auto-VPN is enabled in settings.
2. Trigger a connectivity check; observe tuner decisions.
3. Validate the chosen path with a real request.
4. Report the outcome; disable if it degrades performance.

skills.name: Packet filter design
skills.description: Write precise tcpdump filters.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Decide exactly what traffic matters (host, port, protocol).
2. Draft a narrow BPF filter.
3. Test briefly with tcpdump.capture; adjust.
4. Capture the real session with the final filter.

skills.name: Capture data hygiene
skills.description: Handle captured traffic responsibly.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Treat captured tokens and cookies as sensitive.
2. In reports, show header names, never values.
3. Clear history when done (http.history.clear).
4. Note retention expectations to the user.

skills.name: Replay safety guardrails
skills.description: Avoid harmful replay behavior.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Never replay state-changing requests (POST/DELETE) against production without approval.
2. Prefer read-only endpoints for testing.
3. Use tiny counts with http.capture.repeat.
4. Confirm targets are the user's own systems.

skills.name: Latency breakdown
skills.description: Find where time goes in a slow request.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. curl -w timing breakdown via process.exec (DNS, connect, TLS, TTFB).
2. Repeat 3 times; note variance.
3. Identify the dominant phase.
4. Recommend the targeted fix.

skills.name: Capture-replay pair testing
skills.description: Prove a modification works end to end.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Capture the original with http.capture.
2. Craft the modified variant with http.replay.
3. Compare responses side by side.
4. Document the exact change that produced the difference.

skills.name: Multi-endpoint health sweep
skills.description: Check many endpoints quickly.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List endpoints from http.history or user input.
2. Sweep with small curl checks via process.exec.
3. Record status and latency per endpoint.
4. Summarize a health table.

skills.name: Proxy rotation usage
skills.description: Use the proxy pool effectively.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. ProxyRotator state check via process.exec or app settings.
2. Rotate on failure, not preemptively.
3. Track which proxies serve which requests.
4. Report proxy performance stats.

skills.name: Network baseline profile
skills.description: Establish a device network baseline.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Run diagnostics (cat_net_diag_run flow) against 3 reference hosts.
2. Record latency and loss.
3. Store the baseline with file.write.
4. Compare future issues against it.
